== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-L-sw4ioncannon-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[SW-4 Ion Cannon]] (Decipher; Decipher's [[SW-4 Ion Cannon (Decipher Errata 1998)|November 1998 errata]] was published as text only): The game text changes: “any” becomes “your”; “a starship” is added after “B-wing. May target”; “armor or maneuver,” becomes “defense value,”; “starship” is added after “or maneuver, all”; “aboard” becomes “deployed on”. These are the same words as [[SW-4 Ion Cannon (Decipher Errata 1998)|Decipher's errata]]. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “SW-4 Ion Cannon” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
